cities.name: Minsk
cities.local_food_tip: Try hearty Belarusian meals like draniki (potato pancakes), borscht, draniki with sour cream, and local rye bread — simple, warming and traditional.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Walk across Independence Square and explore historic Soviet‑era monuments. → 🚶 Stroll through Gorky Park or other green zones for a relaxed start.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Visit museums or galleries showcasing Belarusian history and contemporary art. → 🍽️ Lunch: potato pancakes, soups or local specialties. → ☕ Coffee in a cozy city café.

Sunset: 🌇 Walk along the Svislach river embankments or enjoy city skyline views from a vantage point.

Night: 🌃 Experience Minsk nightlife — restaurants, cultural venues or relaxed urban strolls under city lights.

ideas: 🌸 Parks and boulevards get green — nice for walks and city strolls.
🎨 Galleries or small exhibitions open up after winter.
☕ Outdoor cafés start reopening — pleasant for early-season visits.

summer.event: Summer in the City & River Evenings
ideas: 🌳 Relax in city parks during warm afternoons.
🚣 Evening strolls or boat rides near river embankments (if available).
🎶 Outdoor events or cultural evenings as daylight lasts longer.
🍂 Tree-lined streets turn golden — nice for photos and walks.
🥘 Warm soups and comfort food in cozy restaurants as weather cools.
🏛️ Indoor museums are perfect when rainy or chilly.
❄️ Snow‑covered city parks and quiet winter walks.
🔥 Hot drinks, hearty meals and cozy indoor spots after cold walks.
🎄 Winter holiday decorations (if visiting in season) — nice festive vibe.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use metro for efficient travel across city.
🚶 Many central attractions and parks are walkable on foot.
🚌 Use buses/trams for suburbs or outskirts.
🎟️ Consider day‑tickets or combos if exploring many spots.

city_events.name: Minsk Spring Cultural Festivals
city_events.description: 🎭 Local theatre, music and art events as city wakes up after winter.

city_events.name: Summer City Nights
city_events.description: 🌙 Outdoor concerts, street‑art events and riverfront gatherings under long daylight.

cities.name: Mir & Nesvizh (Castles & Historic Sites)
cities.local_food_tip: Local countryside cuisine — soups, fresh bread, simple meat or fish dishes and fresh produce — ideal after historic sightseeing or countryside walks.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Visit the famous Mir Castle — medieval fortress with rich history and scenic surroundings. → 🚶 Walk around its grounds and nearby landscape.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Head to Nesvizh Castle and Estate — beautiful gardens, lakes and historic architecture. → 🍽️ Lunch: regional dishes, fresh produce and rustic flavors.

Sunset: 🌅 Lakeside or castle‑garden walk as evening sets — peaceful and scenic.

Night: 🌙 Stay in a guesthouse nearby or return to Minsk — enjoy quiet countryside air or sunset views over historic buildings.

ideas: 🌼 Gardens bloom and surroundings get green — great for photos.
🚶 Pleasant walks around castle parks without summer crowds.
🎨 Early‑season calm, perfect for peaceful sightseeing.
🌿 Combine castle visits with nature walks or nearby forests.
📸 Photography of historic buildings in summer light.
🍃 Relaxed lunches or picnics in castle parks.
🍂 Golden‑brown foliage around lakes and gardens — very scenic.
🧣 Cozy walks and hearty meals after sightseeing.
🏛️ Indoor tours of castles & historic halls if rainy or cold.
❄️ Snow over castle roofs and frozen lakes — fairy‑tale vibes.
🔥 Warm meals and hot drinks after cold daytime walks.
📸 Snowy landscapes + historic architecture = magical photos.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Use regional trains or buses from Minsk to reach castles.
🚶 Once there — walking is best to explore towns and surroundings.
🚗 Renting a car gives flexibility to visit multiple sites in a day.
🗓️ Check opening times of castles before visiting, seasons vary.

city_events.name: Historical Castle Day Tours
city_events.description: 🏯 Guided tours, local folklore events and historic reenactments near castles.
